description: This PHP class 'DetailedMenuItem' represents a detailed menu item in the OrangeHRM system, allowing for creation, configuration, and nesting of menu items with properties such as id, title, module, screen, and additional parameters.

classes.name: DetailedMenuItem
classes.description: Represents a detailed menu item with properties for id, title, module, screen, and child menu items, and methods to construct from a MenuItem entity and manage child items.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the menu item.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the ID of the menu item.

methods.name: getMenuTitle
methods.description: Returns the title of the menu item.

methods.name: setMenuTitle
methods.description: Sets the title of the menu item.

methods.name: getAdditionalParams
methods.description: Returns additional parameters associated with the menu item.

methods.name: setAdditionalParams
methods.description: Sets additional parameters for the menu item.

methods.name: getModule
methods.description: Returns the module name associated with the menu item.

methods.name: setModule
methods.description: Sets the module name for the menu item.

methods.name: getScreen
methods.description: Returns the screen URL/action associated with the menu item.

methods.name: setScreen
methods.description: Sets the screen URL/action for the menu item.

methods.name: createFromMenuItem
methods.description: Creates a DetailedMenuItem instance from a MenuItem entity, extracting properties and related Screen information.

methods.name: addChild
methods.description: Adds a child DetailedMenuItem to this menu item.

methods.name: getChildMenuItems
methods.description: Returns the list of child menu items.
